title: FinFET Inspection - Micro-cracks Detection on Archer 750
subtitle: Post-CMP Quality Validation for 5nm Node Manufacturing
author: James Rodriguez

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Archer 750 system to detect and classify Micro-cracks defects during post-cmp inspection at the 5nm technology node. The test is conducted at Milpitas Fab B to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Micro-cracks defects that are critical to yield at the 5nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Archer 750 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Archer 750
- Inspection Type: FinFET Inspection
- Target Defect: Micro-cracks
- Process Step: Post-CMP
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 5nm
- Fab Location: Milpitas Fab B

This test case applies to all Archer 750 systems deployed at Milpitas Fab B for post-cmp monitoring in the 5nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Archer 750
Software Version: v14.4.623
Recipe: FINFET_INSPECTION_5nm_POST_CMP
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (120 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 1.0μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: 5-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Archer 750 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'FinFET Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Micro-cracks defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 5nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 57 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 92% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.8% for FinFET Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.97 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2025-01-13
Wafers Tested: 6
Total Defects Found: 2576
Defect Density: 819.97 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 7.5%
Capture Rate: 97.6%
Test Duration: 191 minutes
System Uptime: 97.6%

Result Classification: CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Archer 750 demonstrated acceptable performance in detecting Micro-cracks at the 5nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) No significant drift was observed during the test duration.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
